Eligibility

Your detail unlocks your membership

Aftercare is for customers who have had a qualifying full detail with us. The package you choose first decides which membership you can join.

Initial full detailThe Renewal DetailFrom $249
Eligible membershipRenewal Maintenance Plan$129 per month
Initial full detailThe Revival DetailFrom $349
Eligible membershipRevival Maintenance Plan$149 per month
Initial full detailThe Redeemed SignatureFrom $449
Eligible membershipRedeemed Signature Maintenance Plan$179 per month

Good to know

  • A full detail comes first. A membership cannot be bought on its own.
  • Sign up within 7 days of your detail. You are only eligible to join a Maintenance Plan within 7 days of your full detail being completed.
  • Each detail opens one membership to start with. A Renewal Detail starts you on the Renewal Maintenance Plan, a Revival Detail on the Revival Maintenance Plan, and The Redeemed Signature on the Redeemed Signature Maintenance Plan.
  • Upgrading your membership is easy. You can upgrade to any higher membership tier at any time by simply paying the applicable upgrade fee. Whether you're moving from Renewal to Revival or straight to Redeemed Signature, there's no need to purchase another full detail. We'll confirm your upgrade fee with you before making any changes to your membership.
  • We confirm every application. Applying is an enquiry. We check eligibility personally before anything is agreed.

How it works

Four steps to ongoing care

  1. Choose your full detailing package

    Pick the detail that matches the membership you want to join.

  2. Have your vehicle professionally detailed

    We come to you and complete your full detail.

  3. Select your eligible maintenance membership

    Apply below and we confirm your eligibility.

  4. Enjoy scheduled monthly maintenance visits

    We visit on a regular schedule and keep your quarterly treatments on track.
